title: Crosswalker Shape Preset
description: A shape preset is a level-count-agnostic policy document (spec §3c½). It NEVER names columns or level counts; it speaks in quantifiers — every_level, leaf, tail (plus facets, links). That is what lets one preset serve any ontology, and what makes it the code-level escape hatch: a plain JSON file, schema-validated, writable without the UI, shareable. At instantiation time, detection supplies the concrete levels/facets/links of a specific source and the preset's rules are stamped onto matrix rows (preset × detection → StructureMapping). A preset is deliberately distinct from a saved mapping (which is fingerprint-bound to one source, stored by config-manager) — the two must never be conflated.
$comment: v0.1. JSON Schema 2020-12. Stable URI; breaking changes will bump to /v2/. SchemaVer 1.0.0. Sibling of recipe.schema.json + tier1.schema.json. Column-agnostic by construction: no `$defs.destination` admits a `column` or `key` property, and every object sets additionalProperties:false, so a preset that names a column fails validation (that column-binding is detection's job, not the preset's).

destinationPrimitive.description: One of the Obsidian structuring primitives (spec §7c). folder/name/heading are structure carriers; tag/link/property are metadata carriers (which also carry structure — a nested tag path IS hierarchy); note materializes a level as its own concept note; alias/body are content carriers.

presetDestination.title: Preset destination
presetDestination.description: A destination expressed as GENERIC policy — a primitive plus only its column-independent parameters. Column-bound parameters (a property/link frontmatter key, a tag namespace) are filled from the detection at instantiation, never named here. additionalProperties:false rejects any attempt to bind a column (`column`, `key`, …), which is what enforces level-agnosticism.

path.description: tag only. 'nested' → a nested tag path (#technique/T1055); 'flat' → a single flat tag. Ignored for other primitives.

order.description: tag only. Optional sibling-order hint within a polyhierarchy.

depth.description: heading only. Base markdown heading depth; nested levels increment from here.

direction.description: link only. Which side the frontmatter wikilink is written on.

predicate.description: link only. Typed predicate (e.g. 'skos:broader'). Generic — the concept ids come from the detection.

list.description: property only. True → the property is list-valued.

position.description: body only. Where body content is written into the host note.

presetNaming.description: How a level's name is composed, quantified (no column names). 'part' → the single part; 'prefix' → cumulative prefix; 'joined' → merged pieces joined by the delimiter; 'joined-full' → the whole packed id (used for a leaf that keeps its full notation, e.g. 'T1055.011').

quantifierRule.title: Quantified structural rule
quantifierRule.description: A rule applied to a quantified set of levels — every structural level, or just the leaf. Names the destinations and (optionally) the naming policy; never the columns.

destinations.description: Where each level in this quantified set lands. Plural — a level may land as folder AND tag at once.

tailRule.title: Quantified tail rule
tailRule.description: Policy for the variable-depth tail (the ragged 'however many levels remain' group). Serializes to a `variadic` folder block at instantiation. Column and delimiter come from the ragged detection.

destinations.description: Where the exploded tail levels land (folder only today). Defaults to a single folder destination if omitted.

max_depth.description: Safety cap on tail folder depth.

placement.description: parent-note placement (schema knob pending; carried for forward-compat, not yet serialized).

facetsRule.title: Facets policy
facetsRule.description: How low-cardinality facet detections land. The facet column and its tag namespace come from the detection.

linksRule.title: Links policy
linksRule.description: How parent-column detections land. The parent column and frontmatter key come from the detection.

$schema.description: Optional JSON Schema URI hint for editor autocomplete.

label.description: Human-readable working title shown in the preset picker.

description.description: One-line explanation of the house style this preset encodes.

structural.title: Structural policy
structural.description: How packed / level-per-column hierarchies land. Quantified: every_level applies to each interior structural level; leaf applies to the innermost (leaf-bearing) level; tail applies to the variadic remainder of a ragged hierarchy.
